verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a sandbox, staging, or dev workspace that is isolated from production data. Git sync (docs-11) and the AI 'Compare & Deploy' review page (docs-21) are deployment workflows, not test environments. The community 'sandbox runtime' remark is about execution runtime, and the pre-merge validation comment is only a question, so neither establishes isolated testing against non-production data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
